column_description: Unique identifier for each lighting configuration.
Name of the lighting configuration. may be NULL.
Type of lighting (e.g., directional, point, ambient). always exactly one of 'directional', 'point', 'ambient'. may be NULL.
Intensity of the lighting. may be NULL.
Color of the lighting (RGB values). may be NULL.
Position of the light source (x, y, z) for point lights. may be NULL.
Direction of the light source (x, y, z) for directional lights. may be NULL.
Cone angle for spotlight lights. may be NULL.
Falloff angle for spotlight lights. may be NULL.
Version of the lighting configuration. may be NULL.
Creation date and time of the lighting configuration. may be NULL.
Last update date and time of the lighting configuration. may be NULL.
ID of the user who created the lighting configuration. may be NULL.
ID of the user who last updated the lighting configuration. may be NULL.
